$comment: Informational schema — canonical source is packages/shared/src/interfaces.ts (EventEnvelope, EventTransport, EventData), packages/shared/src/webhook.interfaces.ts (WebhookIngressEnvelope, IWebhookIngressData) and packages/shared/src/channel.interfaces.ts (Channel, ChannelProvider, MessageKind, ChannelEnvelope). This file exists only to aid IDE tooling and documentation. Do not use as validation authority. Every property, enum and required list below mirrors those TypeScript declarations; it is pinned against typed samples by packages/shared/test/unit/envelope-schema.spec.ts.
title: Yoizen messaging envelopes
description: CloudEvents-inspired envelopes for NATS JetStream. Two shapes travel the bus: the stage-1 WebhookIngressEnvelope published by api-gateway before signature verification (no accountid), and the stage-2 EventEnvelope/ChannelEnvelope published by channel-service and every other internal producer (accountid resolved). Producers: api-gateway, channel-service, registry-service, agent-admin-service, ai-agent-gateway. IDs are crypto.randomUUID() (UUID v4). Type format: io.yoizen.<domain>.<channel>.<provider>.<kind>.v1 (DOCS/messaging/envelope.md:77).

Channel.description: Logical communication channel. The `http` channel is implemented (generic HTTP channel, authenticated with the x-http-channel-token header from WEBHOOK_FORWARDED_HEADERS).

MessageKind.description: Channel message kind. Note `webhook_received` is NOT here — it is exclusive to WebhookIngressEnvelope.

EnvelopeCommon.$comment: Properties shared by every envelope shape (packages/shared/src/interfaces.ts:29-57). Carries NO `required` list and NO `accountid`/`data`: those differ per shape and are declared by each concrete definition below.

specversion.description: CloudEvents spec version. Declared as `string`; every producer sets "1.0".

source.description: URI of the service that produced the event

type.description: Reverse-domain event type: io.yoizen.<domain>.<channel>.<provider>.<kind>.v1 (DOCS/messaging/envelope.md:77). Stage-1 receipts obey it as of 2026-07-31 (envelope-drift T05): api-gateway builds io.yoizen.messaging.<channel>.webhook.webhook_received.v1 through services/api-gateway/src/modules/channels/webhook-ingress-type.ts. HISTORICAL — stage-1 envelopes published before that date carry the channel-less io.yoizen.messaging.webhook.received.v1 (6 dot-separated segments against the current 7, counting io.yoizen as a two-segment prefix) and are still in the tracking store, so readers must accept both.

traceid.description: OpenTelemetry trace ID (32 hex chars via activeOrRandomTraceId())

causation_id.description: ID of the event that caused this one. null for root events.

correlation_id.description: End-to-end business flow ID. deriveEnvelope copies it unchanged (envelope.utils.ts:197). Defaults are producer-specific: createChannelEnvelope and api-gateway self-correlate with the envelope's own id, while buildEventEnvelope falls back to a FRESH randomUUID() when `correlationId` is not passed (envelope.utils.ts:332) — pass it explicitly on that path.

producer.description: Service that published the event. Real producers: api-gateway, channel-service, registry-service, agent-admin-service, ai-agent-gateway.

channel.description: Logical communication channel. EventEnvelope declares this as a free `string` (interfaces.ts:42) because internal producers use non-channel values such as "platform"; ChannelEnvelope narrows it to Channel (whatsapp | instagram | telegram | http, channel.interfaces.ts:3,23).

provider.description: Infrastructure provider. EventEnvelope declares a free `string` (interfaces.ts:43); ChannelEnvelope narrows it to ChannelProvider (channel.interfaces.ts:4,24).

idempotencykey.description: Deterministic dedupe key: "sha256:" + hex(sha256(canonicalJson(payload))). Mapped to the NATS Nats-Msg-Id header on publish.

callback_url.description: Optional pipeline extension: URL to POST completion results to (interfaces.ts:50)

adapter_id.description: Optional pipeline extension: adapter ID for webhook delivery auth (interfaces.ts:52)

enrich_adapter.description: Optional pipeline extension: adapter ref for pre-handler enrichment (interfaces.ts:54)

forward_adapter.description: Optional pipeline extension: adapter ref for post-handler forwarding (interfaces.ts:56)

EventTransport.$comment: packages/shared/src/interfaces.ts:13-18 — exactly four declared fields. `headers` is NOT one of them and no producer writes it: until 2026-07-31 createChannelEnvelope spread a `headers` key in here (untyped — a conditional spread bypasses the excess-property check), but the option had no caller so it never reached the wire, and envelope-drift T06 moved it to its declared home under `data` (IChannelEventData.headers for stage 2, IWebhookIngressData.headers for stage 1). Historical envelopes carry no transport.headers either.
EventTransport.description: How the event arrived. Canonical type: EventTransport.

depth.description: Causal chain depth for anti-loop enforcement. Optional. Enforced with a strict `>` against MAX_DEPTH_BY_CATEGORY (envelope.utils.ts:15-22).

EventData.description: Payload metadata and content. Canonical type: EventData.

payload_inline.description: true when the payload is embedded; false for claim-check (large payload)

payload_ref.description: Object Store URI when payload_inline=false. Format: nats://objstore/PAYLOAD-<tenant>/<envelope.id>-payload

payload_checksum.description: sha256 of canonicalJson(payload) bytes. Used by the claim-check consumer for integrity verification.

payload.description: Actual payload when payload_inline=true. null when claim-check.

IWebhookIngressData.$comment: packages/shared/src/webhook.interfaces.ts:15-28 — extends EventData, narrows `payload` to a non-null object and adds raw_body_b64 + headers (+ optional instance).

payload.description: Parsed provider body. Narrowed to non-null on this shape (webhook.interfaces.ts:16).

raw_body_b64.description: base64 of the exact raw request body — required for HMAC signature verification in stage 2.

headers.description: Allowlisted request headers (WEBHOOK_FORWARDED_HEADERS, channel.constants.ts). May include the verification-secret subset (WEBHOOK_SECRET_HEADERS) — stage 2 needs them to authenticate. Record<string, string>.

instance.description: Optional channel-account instance selector from the ingress URL path (account externalId). Absent on the legacy token-only path.

EventEnvelope.$comment: packages/shared/src/interfaces.ts:29-57 — the stage-2 / internal-producer shape. `accountid` is required HERE only; the stage-1 shape below omits it by design.

accountid.description: Logical account ID within the tenant (interfaces.ts:44). Required on this shape; see WebhookIngressEnvelope for the stage-1 shape that deliberately has no account yet.

IChannelEventData.$comment: packages/shared/src/channel.interfaces.ts — extends EventData with the webhook header allowlist forwarded from stage 1. Same shape and same home as IWebhookIngressData.headers, per DOCS/messaging/envelope.md §4.1. Optional: only envelopes derived from a provider webhook carry it.

headers.description: Allowlisted request headers minus the verification-secret subset (WEBHOOK_FORWARDED_HEADERS minus WEBHOOK_SECRET_HEADERS, stripped after the signature check since 2026-08-01): only content-type, x-request-id, user-agent. Record<string, string>.

ChannelEnvelope.$comment: packages/shared/src/channel.interfaces.ts — EventEnvelope narrowed with the channel taxonomy and the stage-2 data block. Not part of the root oneOf because every ChannelEnvelope is already a valid EventEnvelope; reference it explicitly when you need the narrowed enums.

WebhookIngressEnvelope.$comment: packages/shared/src/webhook.interfaces.ts:44-51 — Omit<EventEnvelope, "accountid"> plus pinned producer/domain/provider/kind and IWebhookIngressData. Stage 1 of the webhook bridge: published by api-gateway BEFORE signature verification, when the account is still unknown. Using the tenant id as an accountid placeholder corrupts per-account aggregations (billing), which is why the field is absent rather than empty.
